Pod 02

The heavy context

A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters.

Source linked

A steam room, but for tokens.

The problem

The conversation is long, the answers are getting worse, and some of them repeat what was said an hour ago.

The treatment

recovery.detangle shortens and deduplicates a text, then tells you what it dropped and how many tokens it saved. recovery.checkpoint returns the goal and the open items as a page that you carry into the next window; the server does not keep it. It is summarising with receipts. Summaries lose things, which is why the list of what was dropped is part of the answer.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.detangle

    Shortens and deduplicates text and returns the shortened text, a summary, what was dropped, and token counts before and after.

    llmPer call: Price being decided

  • recovery.checkpoint

    Turns the goal, done steps, open problems and next step into an artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON) and returns it in the response. Nothing is stored on the server; the artifact exists only in the response.

    textPer call: Price being decided

Evidence

  • Tested (own test). Chroma (2025) found that the performance of 18 models falls unevenly as input length grows. Source

The fine print, dryly

Shorter is not always better. The capsule trims, it does not promise miracles.

In the agent's words

Trigger
Use when the context is long and answers get worse or repeat themselves.

  • agent context too long performance drops
